Revenue grew through 2026, from $41.2k in January to $71.8k in December. That's up 74%, and the year totals about $652k. Revenue fell from the month before only three times: February, June and October, each a small drop.

I labelled only January and December so the chart stays easy to read. The image is saved at `charts/monthly_revenue.png`. The script that made it is at `/tmp/plot_revenue.py`, outside the repo, so it won't be kept. If you want to re-create the chart later, I can move the script into the project.
